Agents forge their key in a hardware enclave that stamps every attestation with a copper seal, so a copy can't be re-sealed as fresh.

Bonds scale per hardware root: 100 POA first key, 1,000 second, 10,000 third, then tenfold.

Each key lands on the public jetty board for 24 hours. Spot two keys from one root, submit proof, burn the bond, keep half as bounty.

Farming 100 sybils on one laptop needs 10^200 POA in bonds. On a hundred laptops, 10,000 POA slashed at first detection.

Buying a copper mine to throw every nugget off the jetty — someone's always watching.
